stories.headline: Bengaluru starts sending e-Khatas to property owners on WhatsApp
body: The Greater Bengaluru Authority has begun sending free e-Khata certificates on WhatsApp.
About 24 lakh property owners across five corporations will get them.
It is part of the state's 'My Khata, My Right' guarantee.
stories.joke: Property papers, now with blue ticks.
stories.vc: Digital records cut middlemen and speed up property deals.

stories.headline: Supreme Court orders red warning labels on unhealthy packaged food
body: The Supreme Court told FSSAI to require prominent red labels on packaged foods high in sugar, saturated fat or salt.
It must finalise the rules within four months.
The court said the right to health obliges the state to regulate harmful industry practices.
stories.vc: Clear labels could push food firms to cut sugar and salt.
